about: Questions a caller shows before the plugin builds a new app. The setup skill asks them in this order (interactive), or reads the answers from the request (non-interactive). Each question has at most 4 options, the limit of Claude Code's question tool. Options with a product only appear when that product is in the plugin's scope. A `required` question left with one option in scope is not asked: that option is its answer (for example `products` when the scope has Chat but not Calls). A question whose answer the request already gives is not asked either (skills/setup/SKILL.md, New app step 2). A question with "offered": false is a feature not offered in new-app setup for now: it is left out of the questions (set it to true or remove it to offer it again). A request that names that feature still gets it built, unless its product is not supported yet (config productScope.notYetSupported): that product is declined, never built.
